title: Behind the Scenes of 'The Three Little Pigs'
content: This little feature on the making of "Three Little Pigs" features Walt Disney in a brainstorm session with animators Ward Kimball and Frank Thomas.It appears to be made after the fact, and it seems a little forced and contrived. The video makes it look like it just took a few minutes for the small team to come up with the story concept and the famous tune "Who's Afraid of The Big Bad Wolf?"It was actually the Disney composerFrank Churchillwho wrote the song, which became a popular hit during the Depression.In addition to being animators Ward Kimball (trombone) and Frank Thomas (piano) were  musicians in the jazz band "The Firehouse Five Plus Two."--Thanks, Paulo in Rio
